regional_summary_6h.headline: US-Iran escalation and Israeli Syria incursions dominate southern flank threat picture
bullets: Trump's vow of retaliation after renewed US strikes on Iran, combined with Araghchi's accusations against Netanyahu, signals an active escalation cycle with direct implications for Turkiye's eastern border environment.

Israeli intensification of military incursions into southern Syria alongside a Deir ez-Zor countryside landmine blast killing and injuring eight indicates compounding ground-security pressure across the Syrian corridor adjacent to Turkish territory.

Georgian detention of a pardoned Russian activist pending deportation adds a secondary Russia-facing friction point in the northern Caucasus border zone while G20 Iran sanctions talks underscore sustained diplomatic pressure on Tehran.
regional_summary_6h.watch: US-Iran retaliation rhetoric and Israeli southern Syria operations are the dominant escalatory drivers over the next window.
